summary: R2 extends the existing secondary-insect research with 509,971,606 verified empirical bytes, 68 source records, 26 dataset records, a 57-row population-morphology ledger, exact Linepithema humile brood/caste rules, and future polymorphic-ant candidates. Verified application runtime code was not changed.
completed: Continued from the existing secondary research lineage instead of restarting.
Mirrored and verified five public Drosophila behavior/trajectory files totaling 509,971,606 bytes using provider MD5 and local SHA-256 checks.
Rejected the failed Dryad challenge-page responses through minimum-size validation; no invalid bytes were counted.
Expanded the source catalog to 68 records and dataset catalog to 26 records.
Added 57 population-morphology/life-stage parameter rows alongside the original 92 movement/behavior parameter rows.
Added direct Linepithema humile egg, three larval instar, worker-pupa and male-pupa measurements and explicit queen-brood gaps.
Separated Argentine-ant worker variation from true polymorphic-ant profiles; added future Solenopsis invicta, Atta cephalotes and Pheidole research tracks.
Added full life-stage/sex/morph inventories and surface-visibility priors for Drosophila, German cockroach, bed bug and red flour beetle.
Preserved the durable R2 summary and implementation plan at research commit 5eb2e454941eb0096152fd5f3d667002330aa1f0.
remaining: Implement Wave 1 Drosophila and first-instar German cockroach from the verified app lineage using the R2 evidence model.
Acquire direct adult bed-bug footfall timing before enabling articulated bed-bug release gait.
Acquire direct adult Tribolium leg-phase gait before enabling the fourth articulated species.
Acquire authenticated Pratt 2024 free-walking CSV when available; its 34.43 MB direct target-strain track file remains a high-value P0 source.
Implement Linepithema humile worker correlated morphology, queen/male/callow rigs and brood only in context-appropriate modes.
If a visibly polymorphic ant is desired, build it as a separate species profile rather than adding fake majors/soldiers to Linepithema humile.
Repeat 1:1 scale review, native input safety, representative 1000+ mixed-species performance and full two-hour endurance after implementation.
next_action: Start implementation from the verified application lineage, consuming R2 research commit 5eb2e454 and raw empirical artifact 10578147657. Keep ant runtime regression-clean while adding population identity and Drosophila first.
verification: Selected raw files total 509,971,606 bytes and all five provider MD5/local SHA-256 checks passed.
Downloaded empirical ZIP archive integrity test passed and its SHA-256 is e01abb275ea8888316f33b685a8d486d860409cc76090dcb1dc06b9787bcfef3.
Expanded local research pack JSON/CSV parse passed; 34/34 internal checksum entries passed.
risks: The >500 MB empirical mirror is Drosophila-heavy because open fly motion corpora are much larger; byte count must not be mistaken for equal evidence depth across species.
Siliciano navigation logs are odor/cue-conditioned and must not become baseline locomotion or fake screen-content sensing.
Linepithema humile is monomorphic/unimodal at worker caste level; inventing major/minor/soldier workers would be biologically wrong.
Direct queen-larva/queen-pupa dimensions for the current Argentine-ant profile remain incomplete.
Bed-bug and adult Tribolium leg-phase gait remain release gates.
